text: Overpriced. Won’t buy these again. Not bad towels but way overpriced!

product_metadata.title: White Classic Luxury Bath Towels Large - Cotton Hotel spa Bathroom Towel | 27x54 | 4 Pack | Brown
features: WRAP YOURSELF IN BLISSFUL LUXURY - At the end of a long day, or at the start of a new one, you deserve a little luxury. Transform your home into a sanctuary and your bathroom into a mini spa with the help of White Classic deliciously soft, comfy elegant brown bath towels.

MORE LOFT, LESS WEIGHT - Each towel is spun from fluffy, 700 GSM long staple cotton - soft, durable, lightweight, and wonderfully absorbent. It is more absorbent then any Turkish Cotton Towel. These towels are generously sized at 27 x 54 inches - plenty of room for comfortable lounging after a refreshing shower or relaxing soak.

HOTEL QUALITY TOWEL SET - 100% Combed, ring spun cotton, luxurious hotel quality. with a choice of white, grey, black, navy blue, light blue, brown, burgundy, green, beige and pink. Value bulk pack of four fresh, fluffy towels. Edges are reinforced with double needle embroidered stitching to prevent fraying from long-term use and laundering. And insure quick drying.

EASY CARE - Our bath towels are completely dryer safe and dry very fast too. Simply toss them in the machine and wash. After the first wash, these towels fluff up fresh beautifully and grow even softer.
WE’VE GOT YOU COVERED - Indulge in luxury that lasts with our complimentary 2-year extended warranty.
